_comment: Known data sources for the #217 licence check. ONE source of truth, read by tools/verify_pack.py and documented in docs/contributing/0002-data-licensing.md. `match` tokens are matched case-insensitively against a pack's provenance.source_url and provenance.source_license. `standing` is what the gate reports; the named human key still signs every acceptance.

sources.name: NREL RTS-GMLC
sources.conditions: NREL Data Use Disclaimer Agreement: use, copy, distribute for any purpose; keep the notice with copies; credit DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE in publications; no endorsement use of their names.

sources.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
sources.conditions: ENTSO-E publishes the list of data open for free re-use (CC-BY 4.0 for listed data). The SPECIFIC series must appear on that list; attribute ENTSO-E and the primary data owner.
sources.verified: 2026-08-04, transparency platform terms and reuse list

sources.name: ERCOT public website data
sources.standing: unmodified redistribution only; ship derived aggregates
sources.conditions: ERCOT terms permit use, reproduction and redistribution of public website contents UNMODIFIED with notices retained. A compiled pack's series are modifications, so an ERCOT pack must ship derived values with the source cited, never restated raw series.

sources.name: hand-authored
sources.conditions: Author-created numbers with no external dataset; CC0 or equivalent dedication stated in provenance.
